notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.33.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Khung keo trong MAT CAT A (Filled Region Info_KeoThep) tu cap nhat theo mai vuon: loai 1 = canh keo vuon ra roi be chan dung toi mat tren diem chan mai; loai 2 = canh keo keo theo doc toi cach mep mai 150. Ap dung khung 1 tang, khung thep nhieu tang, keo thep tren cot BTCT. - MAT CAT A luon o giua chieu dai nha, MAT CAT B luon o giua be rong nha (truoc day lenh doi mat cat khong co tac dung). - "Hide at scales coarser than" cua MAT CAT A / B mac dinh 1 : 1000.
